'''''Visit Malastare''''' was a travel advertisement for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], showing a picture of an exotic landscape accompanied by the [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] caption "VISIT MALASTARE". One advertisement was put up as a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] in the cell that [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]] shared in the [[Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center/Legends|Republic Judiciary Central Detention Center]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Deception" /> The poster also appeared in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of a [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] commandeered by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] on [[Stobar/Legends|Stobar]].<ref name="Brothers">{{TCW|Brothers (episode)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
This [[Painting/Legends|poster]] first appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Deception]]."<ref name="Deception" /> It also appears in the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] of the [[Unidentified Turtle Tanker/Legends|Turtle Tanker]] commandeered by [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] in the episodes "[[Brothers (episode)|Brothers]]"<ref name="Brothers" /> and "[[Revenge (episode)|Revenge]]," however, the lighting is so dim that the poster is completely illegible, and you can only the silhouette of the motif.<ref name="Revenge">{{TCW|Revenge (episode)}}</ref>
